No change of mass/material/area/threshold. Use six simultaneous SC-L1 point forces from current full offset maps and relative velocities, real distance/bend force gradients, particle inertia and prismatic opposite reaction. Preset 20 equal RK4 intervals over the original h, four stages per interval, 480 owner force evaluations (<512). Save all stage states and forces and integrate both moments with the same nonnegative RK weights. Use those six histories once to drive the same public finite-XPBD held/terminal diagnostic. Compare returned endpoint gaps, speeds and individual force moments to those of the proposal; the RK sample path does not certify continuous nonpenetration and does not replace the runtime. No retuning or repeated grid. If a stage violates the constitutive domain, save and stop.
next_stage: Only a verified common force/motion path, body/source bindings, both hard sweeps and energy/angular/transactions could release N3. No new native or full-window grant.
